aqwas.description: As a Software Engineer at AQWAS, I contributed to the end-to-end development of dynamic web applications, focusing on delivering scalable and user-centric digital solutions:
bullets: Product Development: Engineered responsive, high-performance web applications using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, prioritizing modern UI/UX standards to enhance user engagement.
Scalable Architecture: Integrated robust backend services via Firebase (BaaS) to manage cloud data, secure user authentication, and support core application logic.
Agile Delivery & Collaboration: Collaborated effectively within cross-functional teams to drive project milestones, utilizing Agile methodologies and Jira to ensure timely product delivery.
Quality Assurance: Maintained high standards of code health through GitHub version control, active code reviews, and proactive technical problem-solving.
Performance Optimization: Continuously monitored, debugged, and optimized system components to maximize application speed, reliability, and overall user satisfaction.

discover_aseer.name: Discover Aseer
bullets: Served as a core developer in building the "Discover Aseer" platform, aimed at providing an interactive digital experience to explore the region.
Contributed to full-stack development, actively working on both Backend and Frontend architectures.
Engineered the "AI Planner" feature, utilizing Artificial Intelligence to help visitors generate smart, customized tourist itineraries.
Built interactive and highly responsive frontend components, focusing on speed, performance, and seamless user experience.
Designed data models and engineered relationships to dynamically integrate a Headless CMS architecture.
Debugged and resolved complex technical issues to ensure seamless data flow and integration between the CMS and frontend interfaces.
Implemented secure authentication flows, account recovery, and cloud email integrations.
Optimized page loading speeds, media processing, and ensured cross-device compatibility.
Collaborated closely with the UI/UX design team (via Figma) and the Quality Assurance (QA) team to ensure high-fidelity implementation.
Contributed to cross-functional teamwork throughout all project phases to deliver a highly robust digital product.

feedanalysis.name: FeedAnalysis | Al-Powered Feedback Monitoring System
bullets: Engineered a full-stack web application leveraging Next.js and Firebase to automate the collection, storage, and analysis of customer reviews.
Integrated the Gemini API as a real-time Al processing engine to perform sentiment classification, generate text summaries, and extract actionable business strengths and weaknesses.
Designed a secure administrative dashboard utilizing Recharts and React Table to visualize KPIs and provide business insights through interactive, filterable data representations.

recipe.name: Al Recipe Assistant | Smart Culinary Web App
bullets: Built a responsive frontend application using React and Vite that dynamically generates customized recipes based on user-provided ingredients.
Integrated the Hugging Face Inference API for Al-driven content generation, utilizing react-markdown to ensure clean, dynamic text rendering and formatting.
